{{Quote|Did a dedicated Imperial Naval Inspector really have to die to protect Ghorman pride?|Engineer officer to Imperial meeting on Ghorman|<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
An [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''naval inspector''' had allegedly [[death|died]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Death Date"/> [[Dee Shambo]] and [[Nisus Osar]], members of the [[Ministry of Enlightenment]], used the death as part of an [[Anti-Ghorman whispering campaign]] to turn galactic opinion against the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman people]]. During a [[Ghorman project|secret Imperial meeting]] at the [[Maltheen Divide]], Shambo and Osar revealed their usage of the naval inspector's death to imperial officials present a the meeting as part of the planned [[Suppression of Ghorman|Imperial suppression]] of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
The naval inspector was first mentioned in the [[One Year Later|first episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
